ourKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
ourKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
ourKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
ourKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
enemyKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade to block then swing for a stun → Spear of Nyr (bonus damage on low targets) → Coliseum leap to finish
enemyKits.winCondition: leap onto a target with Coliseum for doubled Gladiator power and secure kills to stack permanent power
enemyKits.passive: Gladiator stacks grant physical power and heal him as they fall off after combat
enemyKits.playWith: a team that follows his Coliseum leap onto the target
enemyKits.playAgainst: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

loadout.name: Death From Above
loadout.text: Akeron can fire an additional web projectile from the wall or ground once, allowing him to leap from surface to surface or to Root from where he hangs.
loadout.plain: Web Lash gets a second shot from a wall, so you can swing to another wall or root an enemy from above. It makes ganks and escapes much harder to predict.

loadout.name: Krix
loadout.text: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) increased Maximum Health, and bonus size equal to 0.5% of your Maximum Health.

loadout.text: Killing an Enemy Unit restores 0.75% of your Maximum Health and grants 2 Gold.

loadout.name: Cannibalism
loadout.text: Takedowns permanently increase your Maximum Health by 25.
loadout.plain: Every takedown permanently adds 25 max health to Akeron. Consume executes heroes bitten at low health, so each bite that finishes a hero also grows Akeron's health for the rest of the game.

loadout.name: Nyr Warboots
loadout.text: Resilience:  Gain 50% Decaying Movement Speed for 5s. Regenerate 3% of your Max Health every second for 5s.

bullets: Casting Orbital Sanction starts Spear Of Desolation's 10% damage boost for 6s, raising the first stretch of a beam that follows enemies, heroes first, and hits every 0.25s.
Every beam tick and Saturation Charge mine is ability damage, so The Perforator's 10% slow for 1s kept refreshing on enemies caught in the beam or mine field.
Malady adds bonus damage on a hero below 40% health, then goes on a cooldown that takedowns reset, so across 19 kills the finisher kept returning.
Each Refibrillator hit stacked a magical burn, added Prophecy's on-hit damage, and raised Orion's damage boost on that target by 2% per hit, up to 16% for 3.5s.
Hitting heroes with basic attacks and abilities built Triage Protocol to 5 stacks, giving Zinx 25% decaying movement speed and 75% stronger Infuse heals for 5s.
All four items carry ability haste, 55 in total, cutting Neural Regenesis from 120s to about 77.4s, so the revive came back for more fights.
Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies each second, ramping up to 40% more damage on one target, so Web Lash's root and 35% slow hold enemies in the burn.
Taking hero damage gives a Forticus shield for 3.5s, on a cooldown, and separately builds extra Hunger, each stack granting 0.25% more healing from Crushing Maw and Consume.
Void Helm and Vyzar Carapace added 25 ability haste, cutting Consume from 95s to about 76s, so the pull and healing bite came up more often.
